updates.title: Mayor Ammer calls solar panel meeting
updates.text: Which city buildings should get solar panels? Mayor Michael Ammer has called a public meeting for 17 November, 5 pm at town hall.
updates.evidence: Item 2 asks the building, planning and environment committee to choose sites for solar panels to be installed by EVB, the local energy company. No site is listed as approved. The public meeting is in the council chamber at Rathausplatz 1. Minutes appear after the committee approves them.

calendar.summary: Bobingen public committee meeting: solar panels on city buildings
calendar.description: Public meeting of the building, planning and environment committee. Item 2 concerns proposed sites for solar panels. The official agenda gives no end time.

updates.title: Augsburg district tightens spending controls
updates.text: District offices must check spending more closely, including on services for Bobingen. District head Martin Sailer cited pressure on the budget. The order applies only to the district’s spending.
updates.evidence: The district imposed the controls for the 2026 budget year. It expects extra costs for social services and youth services.

updates.title: Bobingen reopens Schnitterstraße
updates.text: The city officially reopened Schnitterstraße on 22 October after renewing 280 metres of road. Owners of properties along the street will not be charged for the work.
updates.evidence: The city says work finished in September. It held the official reopening on 22 October and published its report on 27 October.

activities.title: Parliament agrees changes to EU disaster-response rules
activities.text: The European Parliament agreed changes to proposed rules for disaster and health emergency support. It sent the file back for talks with the Council, where national governments are represented. Final EU rules still need agreement.

updates.title: City grants cooling water permit
updates.text: On 4 November, the environment office allowed Everllence to take water from three streams. View the plans online or at the office from 20 November to 3 December.
updates.evidence: The permit covers groundwater and three streams: Malvasierbach, Stadtbach and Proviantbach. The 13 November gazette (page 302) gives the inspection dates: 20 November to 3 December. Read the decision and plans online or at the environment office, Schießgrabenstraße 4.

follow_up.label: Environment office: documents open for public inspection

updates.title: Augsburg asks what should change in the city
updates.text: The city is collecting ideas for its future until 29 November. Have your say online or on paper at the public information office on Rathausplatz. The city council will decide later.

source.label: City of Augsburg · Invitation to take part

updates.evidence: You can submit comments until 29 November. Paper forms are available at the public information office on Rathausplatz. The city expects the council to make its final decision in July 2027.

follow_up.label: Fill in the city’s online questionnaire

updates.title: Council funds more secondary school places
updates.text: In October, Augsburg City Council approved up to €2.375 million towards expanding Bischof-Ulrich-Realschule. The expansion would create 75 to 98 extra places for pupils who live in Augsburg.

source.label: City of Augsburg · Report on the council decision

updates.evidence: The council approved the grant. The city says the new intake could start in the 2027/28 school year. Its report does not name individual councillors’ votes.
